faqs.question: Does this count spaces as characters?
faqs.answer: Both counts are shown: characters including spaces and characters excluding spaces.

faqs.question: How is reading time calculated?
faqs.answer: Based on 238 words per minute, the commonly cited average adult silent reading rate.

faqs.question: Is my text stored or sent anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. All counting happens locally in your browser. Your text is never transmitted.
